finding: No global security requirement; book search and detail endpoints are public
mitigation: Global bearerAuth in spec, security: [] only on /health; validate alg=RS256, iss, aud, exp, nbf; 30 min token lifetime; CI 401 test on every operation

finding: Loan history and flat number of any member readable by changing memberId in URL
mitigation: Replace with /me and /me/loans using token sub; ownership filter inside SQL WHERE clause; 404 on mismatch; GUID public IDs; CI cross-member test on every /{id} path

finding: Free-text sort parameter likely concatenated into ORDER BY; q has no maxLength
mitigation: sort becomes enum (title, author, createdAt) mapped to fixed columns; q maxLength 100, parameterised, LIKE wildcards escaped; no string-built SQL in code review checklist

finding: SQL connection string and Redis key in plain app settings; dev settings with real values in git history
mitigation: Rotate exposed secrets; managed identity for SQL, Service Bus and Blob; Redis key and JWT signing key in Key Vault via Key Vault references

finding: App Service reachable directly on azurewebsites.net, bypassing Front Door WAF and rate limits
mitigation: Access restriction to AzureFrontDoor.Backend service tag plus X-Azure-FDID header check; HTTPS only; min TLS 1.2; HSTS; blob anonymous access off; 15 min SAS

finding: No rate limit on login (credential stuffing) or on listing creation (catalogue flooding)
mitigation: Front Door WAF rate-limit rule 10 req/min/IP on /auth/login; account lockout 15 min after 5 failures in 15 min; 20 listings per member per hour; 429 with Retry-After

finding: Request bodies logged in full including passwords and phone numbers
mitigation: Disable body logging; telemetry processor drops Authorization header and redacts password, phone, email, address, flatNumber; purge affected log data

finding: Listing response embeds owner flat number and phone for every member
mitigation: Listing DTO returns owner display name only; pickup details only to borrower of an approved loan

finding: Digest messages carry member email and full name
mitigation: Message carries memberId only; worker looks up email at send time
Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff in response-header middleware

finding: CORS allows any origin on mock; risk if production keeps defaults
mitigation: Production CORS allow-list with only the BookSwap web origin; explicit config not framework default
